findings.location: IV. Essence of True Worship, list item 2
findings.source_quote: Casual –becoming so aloof to any form of worship that the One being worshiped becomes obscured by indifference.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “लापरवाही” with “उदासीनता” here and in the corresponding later references, to convey aloofness and indifference rather than carelessness.
findings.translation_quote: लापरवाही –आराधना के हर रूप के प्रति इतने उदासीन हो जाना कि उदासीनता के कारण जिसकी आराधना हो रही है, वही ओझल हो जाता है।
